Shang.name: Zi Lü
Shang.title: Tang of Shang
Shang.note: Founder of Shang; the length of his reign is uncertain.
Shang.note_zh: 商朝开国君主；在位年数不确定。

Shang.name: Pan Geng
Shang.title: Pan Geng
Shang.note: Moved the capital to Yin. The Chronology Project dates Pan Geng and his brothers Xiao Xin and Xiao Yi together to c. 1300–1251 BCE.
Shang.note_zh: 迁都于殷。断代工程把盘庚及其弟小辛、小乙合计定为约前1300—前1251年。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia: Pan Geng died 1277 BC, reigned 28 years, c. 1300 BC start.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科称盘庚卒于前1277年，在位28年，约前1300年即位。

Shang.name: Zi Zhao
Shang.title: Wu Ding
Shang.note: Dates follow the Xia-Shang-Zhou Chronology Project and are estimates.
Shang.note_zh: 年代采用夏商周断代工程的估计。

Shang.name: Zu Geng, Zu Jia, Lin Xin, Kang Ding
Shang.title: Four kings after Wu Ding
Shang.note: Four reigns dated together by the Chronology Project.
Shang.note_zh: 断代工程把这四王合并估计年代。

Shang.name: Wu Yi
Shang.title: Wu Yi
Shang.note: Dates follow the Xia-Shang-Zhou Chronology Project and are estimates.
Shang.note_zh: 年代采用夏商周断代工程的估计。

Shang.name: Wen Ding
Shang.title: Wen Ding
Shang.note: Dates follow the Xia-Shang-Zhou Chronology Project and are estimates.
Shang.note_zh: 年代采用夏商周断代工程的估计。

Shang.name: Di Yi
Shang.title: Di Yi
Shang.note: Dates follow the Xia-Shang-Zhou Chronology Project and are estimates.
Shang.note_zh: 年代采用夏商周断代工程的估计。

Shang.name: Zi Shou
Shang.title: Di Xin (King Zhou of Shang)
Shang.note: Dates follow the Xia-Shang-Zhou Chronology Project and are estimates.
Shang.note_zh: 年代采用夏商周断代工程的估计。

Zhou (vassal west).name: Ji Chang
Zhou (vassal west).title: King Wen of Zhou
Zhou (vassal west).note: Tradition gives him a reign of about 50 years; dates are estimates.
Zhou (vassal west).note_zh: 传统说法他在位约五十年；年代为估计。

Zhou (vassal west).name: Ji Fa
Zhou (vassal west).title: King Wu of Zhou
Zhou (vassal west).note: Ruled Zhou as a Shang vassal state until the conquest in 1046 BCE; accession year is an estimate.
Zhou (vassal west).note_zh: 前1046年灭商以前统治作为商属邦的周；即位年份为估计。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia dates King Wu's reign 1046-1043 BC (or c.1049-1043 BC); died c.1043 BC.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科称周武王在位前1046–前1043年（或约前1049–前1043年），约前1043年卒。

sides.name: Shang
sides.troops_text_zh: 良车七十乘、敢死之士六千人（传统说法）

mingtiao.note: The troop figure comes from the late text Lüshi Chunqiu and is not reliable.
mingtiao.note_zh: 兵力数字出自较晚的《吕氏春秋》，并不可靠。
mingtiao.losses: Jie fled south to Nanchao and died in exile
mingtiao.losses_zh: 夏桀南逃至南巢，死于流放

wu-ding-guifang.note: The Book of Changes says the war lasted three years.

fu-hao.note: An oracle-bone inscription records Fu Hao raising 3,000 men plus 10,000 more to attack the Qiang; she also fought the Tufang, Yi and Ba.
fu-hao.note_zh: 甲骨文记载妇好征集三千人，另征一万人讨伐羌方；她还征伐过土方、夷方和巴方。

di-xin-dongyi.note: The victories exhausted Shang just before the Zhou attack.
di-xin-dongyi.note_zh: 连年征战使商朝在周人进攻前已元气大伤。

routes.name: Tang's war on Jie of Xia
routes.summary: Tang marched from Shang lands past the Xia centre to Mingtiao; the beaten Jie fled south to Nanchao near Chaohu (traditional account).
routes.summary_zh: 商汤从商地出兵，经夏都一带至鸣条决战；战败的夏桀南逃至今巢湖附近的南巢（传统说法）。

routes.name: Pan Geng moves the capital to Yin
routes.summary: Pan Geng moved the Shang court from Yan (by tradition near Qufu) to Yin at today's Anyang, where it stayed until the end of the dynasty.
routes.summary_zh: 盘庚把商都从奄（传统认为在今曲阜一带）迁到殷（今安阳），此后直到商亡不再迁都。

routes.name: Wu Ding's war on the Guifang
routes.summary: Shang armies pushed from Yin into the Shanxi highlands against the Guifang; where the Guifang lived is still debated.
routes.summary_zh: 商军从殷都出发，深入山西高原征伐鬼方；鬼方的具体位置至今仍有争议。

routes.name: Di Xin's eastern campaigns
routes.summary: The last Shang king led long wars south-east toward the Huai River against the Yi peoples.
routes.summary_zh: 商朝末代君王长期向东南用兵，直抵淮河流域征伐夷人。

people.name: Yi Yin
people.known_for: Chief minister who helped Tang found the Shang; later tradition calls him a model minister and credits him with herbal decoctions.
people.known_for_zh: 辅佐商汤建立商朝的重臣，后世奉为贤相的典范，并传说他发明了汤药。

people.name: Fu Hao
people.known_for: A consort of King Wu Ding who led rituals and armies; her unlooted tomb held over 1,900 objects.
people.known_for_zh: 商王武丁的配偶，曾主持祭祀并率军出征；她的墓未被盗掘，出土文物1900多件。

people.name: Tang of Shang
people.known_for: Overthrew the tyrant Jie of Xia at the Battle of Mingtiao and founded the Shang dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 鸣条之战灭夏桀，建立商朝。

people.name: Zhong Hui
people.known_for: Chief minister alongside Yi Yin who helped Tang overthrow the Xia; credited with the Announcement of Zhong Hui.
people.known_for_zh: 与伊尹同辅商汤灭夏的左相，作《仲虺之诰》。

check.n: Matched page is Zhong Hui (225-264) of Cao Wei; entry with death c.1580 BC likely refers to Zhonghui, legendary minister of Tang of Shang; date legendary.
check.n_zh: 匹配页面为曹魏钟会(225-264)；约前1580年卒应指商汤大臣仲虺，年代属传说，无法核实。

people.name: Pan Geng
people.known_for: Shang king who moved the capital to Yin (Anyang), stabilizing the dynasty for the next two centuries.
people.known_for_zh: 迁都于殷，使商朝复兴并稳定两百余年。

check.n: Shang king; reign dates are reconstructed and vary widely between chronologies.
check.n_zh: 商王，在位年代为推算，各家年表差异较大。

people.name: Fu Yue
people.known_for: A former convict laborer raised by King Wu Ding to chief minister, helping bring the Shang to its height.
people.known_for_zh: 由筑墙刑徒被武丁擢为相，辅佐武丁中兴。

people.name: Bi Gan
people.known_for: Loyal uncle and minister of King Zhou of Shang, executed for remonstrating against the king's misrule.
people.known_for_zh: 商纣王叔父，因直言强谏被剖心而死，忠臣典范。

people.name: Daji
people.known_for: Favorite consort of King Zhou of Shang, blamed in tradition for the cruelty that ended the dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 商纣王宠妃，传统上被视为商亡的祸水。

people.name: Weizi Qi
people.known_for: Elder half-brother of King Zhou who left the doomed court and later founded the state of Song.
people.known_for_zh: 纣王庶兄，屡谏不听而去，后受封建立宋国。

people.name: Boyi
people.known_for: Prince of Guzhu who, with his brother Shuqi, starved rather than eat Zhou grain; a Confucian model of integrity.
people.known_for_zh: 孤竹国君长子，与叔齐耻食周粟饿死首阳山。

people.name: Jiang Ziya
people.known_for: Strategist who commanded Zhou forces at the Battle of Muye and was enfeoffed as the first ruler of Qi.
people.known_for_zh: 辅佐文王武王灭商的军师，封于齐，被尊为兵家之祖。

capitals.name: Bo (Yanshi Shang City)
capitals.note: Early Shang city often identified as Tang's Western Bo; dates approximate.
capitals.note_zh: 商代早期城址，多认为是商汤的西亳，年代为约数。

capitals.name: Bo (Zhengzhou Shang City)
capitals.note: Large walled Erligang city; many scholars identify it as Bo. Dates approximate.
capitals.note_zh: 二里冈文化大型城址，许多学者认为即亳都，年代为约数。

capitals.name: Yin
capitals.note: Pan Geng moved the capital to Yin; the site is known today as Yinxu.
capitals.note_zh: 盘庚迁殷，此后商都长期在此，即今殷墟。

capitals.name: Sanxingdui
capitals.note: Walled centre of an independent bronze culture in Sichuan; dates approximate.
capitals.note_zh: 四川独立青铜文化的城邑中心，年代为约数。

capitals.name: Qi (Zhouyuan)
capitals.note: Zhou homeland after Gugong Danfu moved the clan to the foot of Mount Qi; date traditional.
capitals.note_zh: 古公亶父率族迁居岐山之下后的周人根据地，年代为传统说法。

capitals.name: Feng
capitals.note: Built by King Wen; remained a Zhou royal centre beside Haojing.
capitals.note_zh: 周文王所建，此后与镐京并为周的王都。
